# Test fixtures

Real measured impulse responses used by the Dirac golden test (feeding a
unit impulse through the plugin must reproduce the IR itself, since
`δ ∗ h = h`).

Both are stereo ORTF captures from **OpenAIR** (Open Acoustic Impulse
Response Library, University of York, https://www.openair.hosted.york.ac.uk/),
licensed **CC BY 4.0**:

- `Usina del Arte Symphony Hall.wav` — Usina del Arte, Buenos Aires (48 kHz, 2.1 s)
- `Lady Chapel St Albans.wav` — Lady Chapel, St Albans Cathedral (44.1 kHz, 6 s)
